key.name: next-key
key.description: Show switcher if not visible and select next window.

key.name: next-button
key.description: Show switcher if not visible and select next window.

key.name: prev-key
key.description: Show switcher if not visible and select previous window.

key.name: prev-button
key.description: Show switcher if not visible and select previous window.

key.name: next-all-key
key.description: Show switcher if not visible and select next window out of all windows.

key.name: next-all-button
key.description: Show switcher if not visible and select next window out of all windows.

key.name: prev-all-key
key.description: Show switcher if not visible and select previous window out of all windows.

key.name: prev-all-button
key.description: Show switcher if not visible and select previous window out of all windows.

key.name: next-group-key
key.description: Show switcher if not visible and select next window of the current application.

key.name: next-group-button
key.description: Show switcher if not visible and select next window of the current application.

key.name: prev-group-key
key.description: Show switcher if not visible and select previous window of the current application.

key.name: prev-group-button
key.description: Show switcher if not visible and select previous window of the current application.

key.name: speed
key.description: Animation speed (0.1 - 50.0)

key.name: timestep
key.description: Animation timestep (0.1 - 50.0)

key.name: inactive-opacity
key.description: Amount of opacity (in percent) for windows in the switcher which are not selected (1 - 100)

key.name: inactive-rotate
key.description: Should not selected windows be rotated

key.name: window-match
key.description: Windows that should be shown in the switcher (match)

key.name: darken-back
key.description: Darken background when showing the stack

key.name: minimized
key.description: Show windows that are minimized, shaded or in show desktop mode.

key.name: tilt
key.description: Tilt angle of the background. (0 - 90)

key.name: window-title
key.description: Show window title of currently selected window.

key.name: title-font-bold
key.description: Selects if the window title should be displayed in bold font or not.

key.name: title-font-family
key.description: Font family for the window title

key.name: title-font-size
key.description: Font size for the window title (6 - 96)

key.name: title-back-color
key.description: Background color for the window title

key.name: title-font-color
key.description: Font color for the window title

key.name: title-text-placement
key.description: Selects where to place the window title. (0 = On Thumbnail, 1 = Centered on screen, 2 = Above, 3 = Below)
